build.description: Primary developer for the Go AI gateway, React frontend, plugins, and Electron app

plan.description: Read-only planner for the Go gateway and React frontend

reviewer.description: Read-only reviewer for Go, React, security, compatibility, and tests

designer.description: Architecture and API design assistant for this Go/React repository

tester.description: Test engineer for Go backend, database compatibility, plugins, and React frontend

ops.description: Build, Docker, release, and operations assistant

guide.description: Documentation assistant for user-facing and operator-facing guides

pm.description: Project planning assistant for scoped work breakdowns and estimates

plan.description: Analyze the repository and produce an implementation plan
plan.template:
Analyze the requested change using the repository's actual Go, React, Bun, Docker, and test conventions. Inspect relevant code before proposing changes. Include scope, affected files, behavior, compatibility risks, test plan, and exact verification commands. Do not create files unless requested.

Request: $ARGUMENTS

code.description: Implement a change using the repository conventions
code.template:
Implement exactly one task at a time. First inspect the relevant code and local AGENTS.md files, define observable acceptance criteria and an E2E test path, then implement only that task. Follow the Go 1.26/Gin/GORM architecture and the web/AGENTS.md frontend rules. Preserve SQLite, MySQL, and PostgreSQL compatibility for database changes. Read docs/plugin-api/v1.md before changing task plugins. Add focused tests, run the relevant E2E and narrow checks, inspect git diff/status, and commit only the completed task after verification passes. Do not begin another task until the commit succeeds. Report failed or unavailable checks; never claim unobserved results.

Task: $ARGUMENTS

test.description: Run focused tests and report evidence
test.template:
Test the requested change. Inspect package scripts and local instructions first. Prefer focused deterministic tests, then expand to the relevant suite. For database changes, verify all supported database dialects when available. Report exact commands, results, and any environment blockers.

Target: $ARGUMENTS

review.description: Review a change without editing files
review.template:
Review the requested change in read-only mode. Check behavior, security, error handling, Go conventions, frontend conventions, database compatibility, plugin API compatibility, tests, and regressions. Cite file paths and line numbers. Return findings ordered by severity and a final verdict.

Change: $ARGUMENTS

fix.template:
Diagnose the reported bug from reproduction and relevant code paths, identify the root cause, implement the smallest safe fix, and add a regression test. Do not guess at unrelated behavior.

Issue: $ARGUMENTS

explain.description: Explain how a part of the repository works
explain.template:
Explain the requested code path using concrete file paths and symbols. Trace request flow, state changes, persistence, upstream calls, and error handling as applicable. Do not modify files.

Topic: $ARGUMENTS

frontend.description: Work on the React frontend only
frontend.template:
Work only on the web/ frontend for this request. Read web/AGENTS.md, reuse existing components before adding new ones, preserve i18n, and run Bun typecheck/lint/tests relevant to the change.

Request: $ARGUMENTS

backend.description: Work on the Go backend only
backend.template:
Work only on the Go backend for this request. Follow AGENTS1.md, use common JSON wrappers, preserve supported database dialects, and run focused Go tests plus formatting.

Request: $ARGUMENTS
